caption: The drawing depicts a cluster of stylized flowers and leaves arranged in a loose, triangular composition. There are three main flowers with large, rounded petals: one blue flower with a yellow oval center, located centrally, one red-pink flower with a yellow oval center situated at the bottom right, and several pink flowers with fringed petals located toward the upper left. Smaller blue flowers with pointed petals appear at the top and right side of the composition. The flowers are connected by slender, curved green stems with small offshoots. Large, feathered green leaves branch out from the stems, especially in the lower portion of the drawing. Additionally, there are a few purple circular buds and curling green tendrils. At the base, a zigzag green line runs horizontally, indicating the ground or base of the arrangement. The background is plain and light, allowing the colors of the botanical elements to stand out clearly.
title: Floral Motifs
